assertions.name: ways clear of all solids
assertions.detail: 10/1717 centreline samples at 6 m along the 13 named ways stand inside a solid — monuments, houses **and the harbour water**, not monuments alone. Worst: via-portus 3%, via-circa-byrsam 2%, via-navalis 2%.

assertions.name: solid/solid interpenetration
assertions.detail: 0 overlapping pair(s) over 727 solids (697 footprints + 30 harbour-water rectangles), worst 0.0 m. Population is every solid against every other — monuments, houses, quays, moles and the water — with a 0.4 m allowance for the party walls a terrace is made of, and one exclusion: the 30 chords are one basin cut into pieces and are not tested against each other. No soft exemption and no upper escape hatch. Worst pair: none.

assertions.name: intervallum clear behind the circuit
assertions.detail: min 38.0 m at x=-328 over 248 samples across the circuit's real span (-968..1013); 0 sample(s) below the required 35 m, or 70 m over a stair apron.

assertions.name: stair-foot aprons clear
assertions.detail: 6 aprons of 120 × 70 m at x -830, -475, -120, 235, 590, 945. All empty. A 35 m cohort in line fits in every one with 43 m of depth to spare.

assertions.name: roof coverage
assertions.detail: 685 blocks (635 rejected: keepOut 306, density 124, outOfBounds 85, collide 79, drowned 41, masked 21), 40.5 ha of roof over 136.3 ha of walled land = **29.7%**; 57.8 ha of that is carriageway, so roof between street lines is **51.5%**. Split: dense city 28.1 ha, Megara 12.4 ha of walled enclosure. Not a pass/fail: the second figure is the one comparable with an orthophoto, and Megara is a garden suburb that is *supposed* to be empty — see 'dense fabric at the module's ceiling'.

assertions.name: dense fabric at the module's ceiling
assertions.detail: 634 blocks outside the Megara carry 28.1 ha of roof over 49.7 ha of their own lattice cells = **56.5%**, against the cubit module's arithmetic ceiling of 60.9% (a 30.9 × 15.5 m block in a 34.9 × 22.5 m cell) and the 60-70% the archaeology gives for the Carthaginian core. **The gap between this and the pooled figure above is the Megara and the streets, not thin housing.**

assertions.name: every residential quarter builds
assertions.detail: all 16 quarters placed at least one block; the smallest is harbourside at 2.

assertions.name: ship sheds
assertions.detail: 168 built — 30 on the island and 138 round the ring, at the 5.9 m slipway width the British excavation measured. Appian says 220; archaeology gives 160-170. We model the archaeology and the blurb may quote Appian.

assertions.name: nothing the city builds stands under the sea
assertions.detail: 0 of 685 house footprints and 0 of 31 curtain towers have any part of their plan below 0 m. 41 candidate blocks were refused at build for standing within 0.44 m of the datum, which is where the gulf's swell crest reaches. 5 monuments *are* under it and are meant to be — Scipio's mole, the quay-fort, the cut channel and the cothon ring are harbour works built into the sea.

assertions.name: harbour basins at sea level, on quays a man can stand on
assertions.detail: both basins at 0.00 m, the gulf they join at 0.00. Quay freeboard, sampled on the quay belt and not at the basin centre: cothon **2.00 m**, merchant **6.44 m**, both against the 1.8 m of §6.2. Raising a quay is not a fix for a short one — men stand at terrain height, so a lifted quay is one they walk under, and the heightfield has to be cut instead.

assertions.name: monuments planned
assertions.detail: 12 named: cothon, merchant-harbour, quay-fort, tophet, forum, stoa-seaward, stoa-landward, horrea-north, temple-sea, byrsa, cisterns-malga, cisterns-south. Positions are authored final and there is no resolver — see the order-of-operations note in layout.ts. Nothing moves after the ways are projected, which is the failure mode this plan is shaped to avoid.
